{{NPC infobox | image = [[Image:Dunkoro Sunspear armor.jpg|150px]] | affiliation = Order of the Sunspears | type = Human | profession = mo | service = Hero | level = 6...20 | campaign = Nightfall | map1 = [[File:"Dunkoro" concept art.jpg|250px]] | map1-text = Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]]. }} {{quotation|[https://web.archive.org/web/20071212204045/http://www.guildwars.com/gameplay/exploring/elona/heroes/ official website] (archived)|''Master Strategist''
"The outcome of a battle is determined before the first soldier leaves the barracks."
'''Origin:''' Istani
'''Age:''' 48
'''Profession:''' Monk
A lifetime of experience has made Dunkoro the man he is today: a master strategist who knows his way around Elona. He's a veteran of countless battles against pirates, centaurs, desert raiders, Thumpers, and stranger enemies. With that wisdom has come a realization that he's not the best soldier to lead a charge; instead, he prefers to advise those who do. Not everyone accepts his advice, though. Some claim that he's become too careful with old age, that he's lost the edge that makes him a deadly soldier. Time will tell. For any hero who would hesitate before rushing into battle, Dunkoro would be a valuable ally. If you're willing to listen, he's the man with a plan.}} {{quotation|nightfall|A lifetime of experience has made [[Dunkoro]] the man he is today: an elder strategist who knows his way around [[Elona]]. He's a veteran of battles against [[corsair]]s, [[Centaur]]s, [[heket]], desert raiders, and stranger enemies. Although he's faced countless dangers alone, he prefers to spend his time advising other soldiers, offering direction and insight to any soldier who will listen. Unfortunately, not everyone listens to his advice. Most recruits respect him professionally, but personally, he remains distant from everyone below him in rank. When life and death are on the line, he doesn't seem to care about other people's fears and concerns, only results: you win, or you die. With this determined and unemotional approach to warfare, Dunkoro's insights have meant the difference between victory and defeat throughout his career. For any hero who prefers rational strategy over chaos, Dunkoro is the man with a plan.}} ==Locations== *[[Istan]] **{{NPC location|Cliffs of Dohjok}} (during [[Leaving a Legacy]]) **{{NPC location|Plains of Jarin}} (during [[Battle Preparations]]) **{{NPC location|The Tribunal}} (during [[Trial by Fire]]) *[[Kourna]] **{{NPC location|Command Post}} *[[Realm of Torment]] **{{NPC location|Throne of Secrets}} ==Missions== :''R indicates that Dunkoro must be in the party'' *[[Kourna]] **[[Consulate Docks]] R **[[Moddok Crevice]] R *[[Realm of Torment]] **[[Gate of Pain]] R ==Quests== :''R indicates that Dunkoro must be in the party'' '''Quests given:''' *[[Kourna]] **[[Building the Base: Prisoners of War]] R **[[Building the Base: The Interrogation]] **[[Building the Base: The Meeting]] **[[The Foolhardy Father]] **[[A Little Recon]] **[[The Tools of War]] **[[Eavesdropping]] **[[Koss Goes Recruiting]] **[[Melonni Goes Recruiting]] '''Quests involved in:''' *[[Istan]] **[[Leaving a Legacy]] **[[Trial by Fire]] **[[The Time is Nigh]] *[[Kourna]] **[[To Vabbi!]] *[[Realm of Torment]] **[[Uncharted Territory]] R ==Recruitment== [[Image:DunkoroUnlocked.jpg|right]] Complete the primary quest [[Leaving a Legacy]], which is obtained from [[First Spear Dehvad]]. Characters of other [[campaign]]s unlock Dunkoro during the primary quest [[Battle Preparations]], obtained from [[Seamarshal Bendro]]. ==Skills== 5 [[Healing Prayers]], 4 [[Divine Favor]] at level 6; 11 Healing Prayers, 9 Divine Favor at level 15 *{{skill icon|Healing Breeze}} *{{skill icon|Healing Touch}} *{{skill icon|Orison of Healing}} *{{skill icon|Remove Hex}} *{{skill icon|Resurrect}} *{{skill icon|Words of Comfort}} ==Armor== Dunkoro starts with basic monk armor, which includes a [[Monk headgear|Prophet's Scalp Design]], labeled as Sunspear Armor but with its own unique appearance. The headpiece provides +1 in the attribute of the rune applied to it. His [[armor rating]] ranges from 3 to 60, depending on his level. The appearance of his armor can be upgraded to [[Elite Sunspear Armor]] using [[Stolen Sunspear Armor]] acquired from the [[Dajkah Inlet]] [[Challenge Mission]]. The appearance of his armor can be upgraded to [[Primeval armor]] using [[Primeval Armor Remnants]] acquired in the [[Domain of Anguish]] and during [[the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]] mission. See Dunkoro's [[Dunkoro/Armor gallery|armor gallery]]. ==Dialogue== In the Cliffs of Dohjok and the Command Post: :''"You can't just run off without a plan. Let me help you. I've been with the Sunspears for years. I plan our strategies. Kormir executes them. Let me do the same for you."'' In The Tribunal: :''"Choose your words carefully; the slightest implication will have great repercussions."'' In Throne of Secrets: :''"I never could have planned for this day... but all the same, I am glad to see it."'' ==Quotes== :''"A general and a soldier go into the same box when the game is done. Remember that."'' :''"He who has never learned to obey can never learn to command."'' :''"I was thinking... perhaps we're going about this wrong. The enemy may be prepared for our attack. We should investigate further."'' :''"Stop walking before you start thinking, or you're going to fall into a hole."'' :''"The very definition of a hero is one who is afraid... and goes on."'' ===Storyline quotes=== Quotes in the context of the Nightfall storyline: *[[The Honorable General]]: :''"It is in our best interests to be at our best when we meet these Kournans. The more honor we show them, the more honor we may bring to the council table when the Elders talk politics."'' :*Before accepting the reward: ::''"First Spear Dehvad was right. I can only hope that Kormir's plan leads to the rise of the First City... and not a repeat of its destruction."'' *Between The Honorable General and [[Signs and Portents]]: :''"General Morgahn is very generous. I am uncomfortable with Warmarshal Varesh and the Kournans, but perhaps not all of them are as foul as she."'' *Signs and Portents: :''"Those ruins provide a great deal of cover for possible ambush. Keep your eyes open, I have a feeling this will be very dangerous."'' *[[Jokanur Diggings]]: :''"This [[Melonni]] seems impulsive, but I have to admit she is right more often than she is wrong."'' *Between Jokanur Diggings and [[Isle of the Dead (quest)|Isle of the Dead]]: :''"This beast, the Apocrypha. I have never heard of it. First Spear Dehvad in Kamadan should hear about this. Immediately."'' *Isle of the Dead: :''"There may be more information in those ruins; other things that will help us understand what [[Varesh]] is up to. Keep your eyes open."'' *Between Isle of the Dead and [[Bad Tide Rising]]: :''"Hmm. First Spear Dehvad must have known what it would cost to retake the First City. Maybe he'll tell us more when we return and tell him what we've done."'' *Bad Tide Rising: :''"These demons have shown up in [[Kamadan]] because of the [[Apocrypha]], I am sure of it. Keep your head down."'' *Between Special Delivery and [[Big News, Small Package]]: :''"[[Castellan Puuba]] mentioned he'd gotten information on those corsairs.
